steps.code:
# Fetch all pages of the song library and liked songs
all_song_library = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_song_library.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

all_liked_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_liked_songs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print("Song library count:", len(all_song_library))
print("Liked songs count:", len(all_liked_songs))
print("Song library IDs:", [s['song_id'] for s in all_song_library])
print("Liked song IDs:", [s['song_id'] for s in all_liked_songs])
